title: Uber and China’s Pony.ai plan to launch robotaxis in London
snippet: The two companies said on Thursday that they would begin testing Pony.ai's Gen-7 robotaxis in London in the coming weeks.

title: Vesta raises $30M to bring swarms of agents to mortgage lenders
snippet: Vesta, an AI-native software startup that helps lenders originate mortgages, announced a $30 million round led by Conversion Capital.

title: India rejects Elon Musk’s claim of discrimination over Starlink launch
snippet: Starlink is still awaiting security clearance before it can seek spectrum and begin commercial services in India.
